hook: A steel ship floats while a steel bolt sinks. A hydraulic lift raises a car with the push of one hand. Blood moves faster through a narrowed artery. All of Unit 8 rests on two simple ideas you meet here: what makes something a fluid, and how much mass is packed into each cubic meter of it.

prereq.q: Which is the SI unit of mass?
prereq.why: Mass is measured in kilograms in SI; the newton is a unit of force.

prereq.q: How many cubic centimeters are in 1 m³?
prereq.why: 1 m = 100 cm, so 1 m³ = (100 cm)³ = 10⁶ cm³.

figure.caption: Particles in a solid, a liquid and a gas, and the definition of density.

chain.cause: In a solid the particles are held in fixed positions
chain.effect: the solid keeps its own shape

chain.cause: In a liquid or gas the particles can move past one another
chain.effect: the material flows and takes its container's shape: it is a fluid
a liquid is nearly incompressible, so its density stays almost constant

chain.cause: The model of an ideal fluid ignores compression and internal friction
chain.effect: a fluid is described by one fixed density ρ = m/V

ideas: A fluid is a substance that flows: a liquid or a gas. Its particles can slide past each other, so it has no fixed shape.
Density is mass per volume, ρ = m/V, in kg/m³. It belongs to the material: cut a sample in half and its density does not change.
Unit check: 1 g/cm³ = 1000 kg/m³. Water is about 1000 kg/m³, aluminum 2700 kg/m³, air about 1.2 kg/m³.
An ideal fluid is incompressible (constant density) and nonviscous (no internal friction). Treat every fluid on the exam as ideal unless told otherwise.

misconception.wrong: A bigger or heavier object has a greater density.
misconception.right: Density is mass per volume. A large block of aluminum and a small one have the same density; a small gold ring is denser than a large aluminum pan.

summary: Fluids (liquids and gases) flow because their particles can move past one another; density ρ = m/V is a property of the material, and an ideal fluid is incompressible and nonviscous, so its density is constant.
